reason.connectionRefused: Connection refused: the key's port answered with a reset (from the server or from a filter on the way)

verdict.refused: Connection refused: the connection to the key's port was reset. The reset may come from the server or from a filter on the way

mode.whitelist: Only whitelisted Russian sites are reachable
mode.serverBlocked: A server's IP address is blocked

advice.whitelist: Foreign servers cannot be reached with any protocol. Only a server whose entry is in a whitelisted Russian range (a cascade) can work
advice.udpBlocked: Neither QUIC nor other UDP passes: Hysteria2, TUIC and WireGuard will not work here, choose TCP servers (VLESS Reality, Trojan). The app prefers them on its own
advice.dohBlocked: The app falls back to Yandex DoH and DNS over TCP; connecting is not affected
advice.serverBlocked: Changing the port or the protocol will not help: choose a server with another IP address
advice.freeze: The network cuts transfers to foreign hosting after the first ~16 KB: choose XHTTP or servers at other hosting providers

summary.open: No restrictions found: foreign sites, transfers past 16 KB, QUIC and UDP work
summary.offline: No internet access: none of the reference sites answered
summary.notVerified: No restriction confirmed, but not every check passed

dns.ok: The system DNS and DoH answer
dns.dohForeignCut: The system DNS answers, DoH to a foreign resolver does not pass, Yandex DoH works
dns.dohCut: The system DNS answers, DoH does not pass
dns.systemFailed: The system DNS does not answer, DoH works

step.tcp: Connection: Russian sites {{ru}} of {{ruTotal}}, foreign {{foreign}} of {{foreignTotal}}
step.tls: TLS handshake: Russian sites {{ru}} of {{ruTotal}}, foreign {{foreign}} of {{foreignTotal}}

bytes.frozen: The transfer froze at {{kb}} KB — the 16 KB freeze signature
bytes.failed: The transfer broke off at {{kb}} KB
bytes.notRun: Not checked: foreign sites are unreachable

udp.ok: UDP passes: QUIC on port 443 and STUN on other ports answer
udp.blocked: UDP does not pass: neither QUIC on port 443 nor STUN on other ports answers
udp.quicCut: UDP passes, but QUIC on port 443 gets no answer: Hysteria2 and TUIC on port 443 may not connect (Salamander obfuscation or another port helps)
udp.quicOnly: QUIC on port 443 answers, UDP on other ports (STUN) does not

dnsTun.ok: DoH answers past the tunnel; the system's DNS queries are answered by our tunnel's resolver
dnsTun.dohForeignCut: DoH to a foreign resolver does not pass past the tunnel, Yandex DoH works; the system's DNS queries are answered by our tunnel's resolver
dnsTun.dohCut: DoH does not pass past the tunnel; the system's DNS queries are answered by our tunnel's resolver
dnsTun.systemFailed: Our tunnel's resolver did not answer the system's DNS query; DoH past the tunnel works
dnsTun.failed: Neither our tunnel's resolver nor DoH past the tunnel answers

canary.captured: The tunnel answers the system's DNS queries
canary.escaped: Something other than the tunnel answers the system's DNS queries: a DNS leak is possible
canary.noAnswer: The system DNS did not answer: DNS capture not verified
canary.notCaptured: Proxy mode does not capture DNS: programs ask the system DNS directly
